breakdown.description: The prompt uses the twist limit directly in degrees inside a torsion formula that returns φ in radians unless the limit is converted.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction to use degrees directly in the formula. Instead, it explicitly converts φ_allow = 0.75° to radians (0.013090 rad) before substituting into the torsion formula φ = TL/(JG), which is consistent with the ground truth prompt that simply omits the incorrect degree-usage instruction.
